name: vennix-storefront
description: Vennix — premium editorial storefront for Shopify. The Node presentation layer renders the storefront and hands cart/checkout to Shopify; the OS 2.0 theme in shopify-theme/ is the in-Shopify twin. Zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node -e "require('./lib/settings');require('./lib/auth');require('./lib/cart');require('./lib/ui');require('./lib/layout');require('./lib/api');require('./lib/ratelimit');require('./lib/shopify/catalog');require('./lib/shopify/cart-api');require('./lib/pages/home');require('./lib/pages/catalog');require('./lib/pages/product');require('./lib/pages/cart');require('./lib/pages/checkout');require('./lib/pages/account');require('./lib/pages/content');console.log('all modules load cleanly')"
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:shopify && npm run check:render && npm run theme:check && npm run smoke && npm run features && npm run links && npm run browser:test
